description: Which of this company's agents may be in its chats (PM-1247): 'mode' is 'all' (the default), 'none', or 'chosen' — then only the agents in 'roles'. An agent already in a chat that the choice bars stays there and answers nobody. 'mayChange' says whether you may change it — the company's owner only, with set_chat_agent_policy.
name: get_chat_agent_policy
title: Get chat agent policy
